content: Registry: use Microsoft.Win32.Registry/RegistryKey (in shared framework, no extra package needed) for read/write, prefer safe GetValue/OpenSubKey with null-check over throwing, scope to LocalMachine only where required. Services: System.ServiceProcess.ServiceController is NOT in the .NET 8/9/10 shared framework for non-Windows-Desktop projects and must be added as an explicit NuGet package (System.ServiceProcess.ServiceController, targets net8.0+); use it for start/stop/query, fall back to sc.exe config via Process for startup-type changes ServiceController does not expose directly.
